jobs.prompt: Production pixel-art sprite sheet for the existing cozy village game. TRUE transparent RGBA background. Exact uniform grid FOUR COLUMNS x SIX ROWS, portrait 2:3 aspect, preferably 1024x1536. Four columns are four successive WALK-IN-PLACE frames (left contact / passing / right contact / passing). Same character scale, foot baseline and camera angle across each row, no translation across cells. Center each sprite at 50% of cell width, feet near 94% cell height, full height about 85% of cell, leave 7% transparent margin. Clear pixel clusters suitable for downscaling to 80x80 per adult or 64x64 child. Visible alternating legs and arms. No text, labels, grid lines, ground, shadows, background, reflections or watermark. The supplied two sheets are IDENTITY / SCALE / STYLE references only. Keep the same six identities, clothes and warm dark-brown outlines: row1 male_a, cream crossed shirt, brown belt/trousers, dark topknot; row2 male_b, broad straw hat, olive shirt, brown trousers; row3 female_a, high bun with red ribbon, cream crossed shirt, terracotta skirt; row4 female_b, dark ponytail with green ribbon, cream crossed shirt, olive skirt; row5 boy, messy brown hair, ochre tunic, dark shorts; row6 girl, two side hair buns with red ribbons, terracotta tunic, dark shorts. Last two rows are CHILDREN and should have the same child proportions as the second reference. No baby or elder. ALL 24 sprites MUST show the BACK OF THE CHARACTER walking AWAY from viewer toward screen UP. We see backs of heads, backs of hats and clothing; NO eyes, nose, mouth, faces or front crossed collar visible. This is not a mirror of a front view. Feet alternate lifting away. Slight overhead camera identical to references.
